headline: Approved a six-unit conversion at 308 Lake Avenue and a three-unit addition at 106 Longwood Avenue; denied rehearing for Wellington Road subdivision.
summary: Variances were granted for projects at 308 Lake Avenue, 106 Longwood Avenue, and 102 Talbot Street, along with several smaller requests. Three cases, including 26 Titus Avenue, were postponed to September 10, 2026. A request for rehearing on the Wellington Road subdivision was denied 4-1.
decisions: Approved variances for a second-floor addition at 235 Carnegie Street, 5-0.
Approved variance for an 8-foot fence in the street yard at 44 Cricket Lane, 5-0.
Approved variances for a six-unit small multi-family at 308 Lake Avenue, 5-0.
Approved variances for a three-unit apartment house at 106 Longwood Avenue, 5-0, with conditions on a window and parking plans.
Approved a 6-foot street yard fence and wetlands setback variances at 15 Windswept Road, 5-0.
Approved a 4-foot side yard setback variance for a carport at 146 Maynard Avenue, 5-0.
Approved subdivision variances at 102 Talbot Street and Crawford Street, 5-0, with a condition on driveway stub locations.
Denied the request for rehearing on the Wellington Road subdivision variance, 4-1.
Postponed the case for accessory vehicle storage at 2188 Candia Road to September 10, 2026.
Postponed the case for an auto repair lot expansion at 2266 Candia Road to September 10, 2026.
Postponed the case for two townhouse buildings at 26 Titus Avenue to September 10, 2026.
Approved the July 9, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 5-0.
